inputs.original_text: DSD athletes also face exclusion from future Olympics IOC says move will protect fairness and safety’ The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: The IOC is calling it “fairness and safety,” but that language looks like cover for a decision about who is allowed to belong. The ban on transgender women and DSD athletes in the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games gives the institution power to define the category, then presents that power as neutral science. Coventry’s claim — “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category” — shuts down debate while making the exclusion sound inevitable. That’s not proof this is only about fairness; it’s a warning about who gets to set the rules.
